content.text:
Final review complete. No further changes needed.

Summary:
- Single edit in src/dotenv/parser.py: `_rest_of_line` reordered to `r"[^\r\n]*(?:\r\n|\r|\n)?"`, so CRLF is consumed as one complete newline during error recovery.
- This now matches the ordering convention of `_newline` and `_end_of_line` in the same module.
- Behavior: invalid binding's `original.string` includes the full CRLF; the following valid binding starts at line 2 with `original.string == "GOOD=ok\r\n"`. LF and lone-CR paths are unchanged, and repeated invalid lines each consume exactly one newline.
- Only src/dotenv/parser.py was modified; tests, docs, other modules, and dependencies were untouched.
- Host acceptance and selected upstream regression tests passed.

Remaining limitations: none identified. The fix is scoped strictly to the error-recovery newline consumption; no other parser behavior was altered.
